items.vn: (verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác
items.example: She removes her makeup before going to bed.

sections.title: Section 1: Basic Details Of Project
sections.html:
phase

(noun). giai đoạn

Now that we've thought of a good idea; the next phase is to find more information.

allocate

(verb). phân phối tiền, thời gian cho việc gì đó

I allocate a different amount of money to each goal.

staff

(noun). nhân viên

The company is conducting a research into its staff.

optimistic

(adjective). lạc quan, tích cực

It's important to keep an optimistic attitude, even when in bad situations.

leave

(noun). nghỉ phép

Though he's on sick leave, he still can't stop thinking about work.

chip in

(verb). góp sức, hỗ trợ

All the kids in the class chipped in to help their friend.

assistance

(noun). sự giúp đỡ

Due to her age, she requires assistance in order to travel.

pressure

(noun). áp lực

I've been under a lot of pressure at work lately.

questionnaire

(noun). trắc nghiệm, bản điều tra

A questionnaire shouldn't be too long, or else people won't want to complete it.

poll

(verb). thăm dò ý kiến

Over 50% of those that were polled said that they would vote for him.

silly

(adjective). ngớ ngẩn

She loves making silly faces.

function

(verb). hoạt động

She doesn't usually function well in the morning because she never gets enough sleep.

appendix >> appendices (plural)

(noun). phụ lục

The appendices are normally found at the end of the book.

supplementary

(adjective). bổ sung, phụ thêm

In addition to eating more fruits and vegetables, it's also a good idea to take some supplementary vitamins.

booklet

(noun). sách nhỏ, sách quảng cáo

The university gave each new student a booklet on the first day.

attach

(verb). nối vào, gắn vào

Remember to attach your file to your email before sending it.

relevant

(adjective). có liên quan

In order to convince people, you need to know what kind of information and ideas are relevant to them.

access

(verb). truy cập

Nowadays, hackers can access private information very easily from anywhere in the world.

submit

(verb). nộp

She submitted the report to her manager on time.

deadline

(noun). hạn chót

We barely have enough time to finish our tasks before the deadline.

approval

(noun). sự chấp thuận

Our work has been given the stamp of approval from the boss.

mutual

(adjective). chung với nhau

Although they are competitors, they still treat each other with mutual respect.

colleague

(noun). đồng nghiệp

I find it very lucky to have colleagues that I can work well with.

guarantee

(verb). đảm bảo

The store guaranteed that we would be happy with the product or they would give us back our money.

agenda

(noun). lịch trình, kế hoạch

There are five things to discuss in the agenda for today's meeting.

budget

(noun). ngân sách

We have a big budget to spend on this project.

get away with

(verb). tránh bị phạt, tránh bị bắt

He committed a lot of crimes but always managed to get away with them.

sections.title: Section 2: Schedule Of Repairs
sections.html:
leaky

(adjective). dột, rỉ nước

The pipes under the kitchen sink are leaky.

roof

(noun). mái nhà

There were a few birds on my roof this morning.

substantial

(adjective). đáng kể, to lớn

She successfully manages to lose a substantial amount of weight.

ceiling

(noun). trần nhà

The hotel room has a pretty interesting ceiling design.

nest

(noun). tổ chim

We found a nest with a few baby birds in it.

crawl

(verb). bò

Before they learn how to walk, babies first learn to crawl.

cavity

(noun). lỗ hổng

I went to the dentist and he told me I have several cavities in my teeth.

address

(verb). đề cập đến

I think we really need to address this problem before it gets worse.

site

(noun). địa điểm

A lot of activities are going on at the building site.

discolored

(adjective). bị phai màu, bị ố

She drinks too much tea and coffee, which makes her teeth discolored.

wiring

(noun). dây điện

I called an electrician to check the wiring in the house.

power

(noun). điện

Nowadays, more and more countries are using solar power.

furniture

(noun). đồ nội thất

The first thing I did when I moved into my new house was buying new furniture for the living room.

stain >> stained (adj)

(noun). vết ố

Can you do anything about the coffee stain on the carpet?

shed

(noun). kho

We keep our gardening tools inside a small shed.

investigate

(verb). điều tra

A common thing to do when investigating a crime scene is to look for fingerprints.

chirp

(verb). hót

Birds chirp in order to communicate with other birds.

wildlife reserve

(noun). khu bảo tồn động vật hoang dã

It's important to protect wild animals by placing them in a wildlife reserve.

firewood

(noun). củi

The firewood needs to be left outside to dry until they are ready to be used.

license

(noun). giấy phép

If you pass the driving test, you will receive your driving license.

object

(verb). phản đối

He strongly objected to their ideas.

dispose

(verb). bỏ, vứt rác

Remember to dispose of your single-use face masks after you wear them.

pile

(noun). đống

There's a big pile of dirty clothes in the middle of his room.

rest assured

(verb). cứ yên tâm

The doctor told us to rest assured, as she didn't have any bad news.

extent

(noun). mức độ

So, to what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

minor

(adjective). nhỏ, không đáng quan ngại

He has a minor paper cut on his finger.

remove

(verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác

She removes her makeup before going to bed.

request

(noun). yêu cầu

If you have any special request, just put it in this box.

suburb

(noun). ngoại ô

We moved from the city to a much quieter and more peaceful suburb.

moisture

(noun). độ ẩm

There's a lot of moisture in the air today.

sections.title: Section 3: Courses Discussion
sections.html:
dull

(adjective). nhàm chán

This book is so dull and boring.

subtitle

(noun). phụ đề, tiêu đề phụ

The subtitle of the book is usually placed under main title.

semester

(noun). học kì

A normal school year is usually divided into two semesters: the fall semester and the spring semester.

perspective

(noun). quan điểm

Everyone has a different perspective on the problem.

oversimplify >> oversimplification (noun)

(verb). đơn giản hóa quá mức

I think you are oversimplifying the solution to the problem here.

clarify

(verb). giải thích, làm rõ hơn

He really clarified the issue for me and made me understand it.

coherent

(adjective). mạch lạc, chặt chẽ

To make your paragraph more coherent, you should have a topic sentence in the beginning and all the other sentences should support it.

political

(adjective). mang tính chính trị, tính công cộng

Climate change has become a political issue, especially when some politicians are still denying its existence.

examine

(verb). xem xét

Let me examine this letter for a minute.

briefly

(adverb). ngắn gọn

First, let's briefly take attendance, and then we can begin.

rewarding

(adjective). bổ ích, làm thỏa mãn

Her job does not pay much, but she finds it very rewarding.

boil down to

(verb). tóm lại, rút gọn lại

All his problems can be boiled down to a lack of money.

cup of tea

(noun). thứ yêu thích của ai đó

Doing paperwork is definitely not his cup of tea.

pursue

(verb). theo đuổi

He's pursuing a career in medicine.

criticism

(noun). lời chỉ trích, phê bình

He doesn't handle criticisms well.

sections.title: Section 4: The Movement Of Population Towards Cities
sections.html:
originally

(adverb). ban đầu, trước đây

Originally, the Statue of Liberty wasn't blue in color.

mercantile

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Mercantile activities were extremely important to the development of ancient Greece.

deserted

(adjective). bỏ hoang

The town is now completely deserted and no one lives there anymore.

vigor

(noun). sức sống, sinh lực

She's always full of energy and vigor.

numerous

(adjective). nhiều

There are numerous things you can do with the internet.

downtown

(noun). trung tâm thành phố

Let's go downtown to find a place to eat.

phenomenon >> phenomena (plural)

(noun). hiện tượng

Aurora, or the Northern Lights, is a natural phenomenon that sometimes happens in Northern Europe.

widespread

(adjective). lan rộng, trên diện rộng

Widespread use of face masks could prevent the spread of the virus.

obvious

(adjective). rõ ràng, hiển nhiên

It's obvious that she doesn't like broccoli.

industrialization

(noun). sự công nghiệp hóa

Industrialization has been known as one of the leading causes of environmental pollution.

agriculture

(noun). nông nghiệp

Agriculture in the area has been negatively affected by climate change.

husbandry

(noun). việc chăn nuôi

Animal husbandry is a big part of farming.

cage

(noun). chuồng, lồng

I bought a new cage for my hamster yesterday.

overhead

(noun). kinh phí, tổng chi phí

We need to find ways to reduce our overheads.

revenue

(noun). thu nhập

Our revenues have been steadily increasing over the years.

distinctive

(noun). đặc trưng, nổi bật

It's not enough to just be different from the rest; you need to be distinctive.

spring

(noun). suối nước ngầm, mạch nước ngầm

Tourists from all over the country travel here to enjoy the natural hot springs.

angle

(noun). góc độ, góc nhìn

Everyone looks at the problem from a different angle.

revitalizing

(adjective). hồi sức, bồi bổ sức khỏe

Doing yoga near a beach can be so revitalizing.

utilize

(verb). sử dụng, tận dụng

You need to utilize every single online platform to grow your business.

preserve

(verb). bảo quản

Putting fruits and vegetables in the fridge helps to preserve them and keep them fresh for longer.

characterize

(verb). biểu hiện đặc điểm, tính chất chính của cái gì đó

The area is characterized by its huge floating market.

facilities

(noun). các phương tiện, công cụ, trang thiết bị

Some housing facilities were damaged by the storm.

thriving

(adjective). thành công

Despite the global pandemic, the business is still thriving.

labor-intensive

(adjective). tốn công, tốn sức

Rice production can be a very labor-intensive process.

dozen

(noun). một tá, mười hai

Can you get me a dozen eggs from the supermarket?

competitive

(adjective). mang tính cạnh tranh

The market right now is extremely competitive, as everyone wants to be the best.

at length

(adverb). một cách chi tiết và cụ thể

They discuss the issue at length during the meeting.
